headline: Central Bank of Brazil Announces FX Line Auction of Up to $2 Billion
summary: The Central Bank of Brazil scheduled foreign currency line sales of up to $2 billion to be settled on November 30 to support domestic FX market liquidity.
why: Central bank foreign exchange interventions directly impact emerging market currency volatility and bank liquidity pools.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Direct central bank dollar liquidity injections relieve depreciation pressure on the domestic currency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The central bank's announcement of dollar line auctions provided liquidity, stabilizing the Brazilian real against the dollar.
